  - `show_liked_songs(access_token, page_index=0, page_limit=5)` — GET `/liked_songs`; returns `song_id`, `title`, `album_id`, `duration`, `artists`, `liked_at`
  - `remove_song_from_queue(position, access_token)` — DELETE `/music_player/song_queue/{position}`; position is 0-indexed
  - `play_music(access_token, song_id?, album_id?, playlist_id?, queue_position?)` — POST `/music_player/play`; at most one of song_id/album_id/playlist_id/queue_position; if none passed, plays current song in queue
- **Supervisor API**: `show_account_passwords()` — GET `/account_passwords`; no parameters; returns list of `{account_name, password}`
